messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Romanian-language MMORPG-style game about immortality and cultivation.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Creaza un mmorpg cu imortal si cultivation”.
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained, single-player browser game titled “Calea Nemuritorului — Tărâmul cețurilor”; multiplayer is not implemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a canvas-rendered cultivation game with forest scene, player and wolf, combat, meditation, Qi cultivation and breakthroughs, quest progression, inventory, techniques, responsive touch controls, and localStorage saves.
- Added `index.html`; JavaScript passed `node --check`.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and opened the game in Playwright.

### Active
- Fix broken stylesheet: Playwright inspection showed `.topbar` computes to `position: static` despite CSS declaring it absolute. Screenshot showed the scene/UI was not rendering as intended.
- After CSS repair, verify gameplay and capture a latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect browser CSS rule parsing/errors and fix the stylesheet so `.topbar` and other interface panels are positioned correctly.
2. Reload the page, test combat, cultivation, inventory, and mobile layout; check browser console for application errors.
3. Save and inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width no greater than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation (HTML, CSS, canvas scene, UI, and gameplay logic).

## Important Context
- Playwright showed `.topbar` computed `position: static`, `top: auto`; the CSS source declares `.topbar{position:absolute;z-index:3;...}`. Investigate CSS parsing; likely malformed CSS before the selector.
- Initial Playwright console error was only `favicon.ico` returning 404.
- `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` succeeded for extracted inline JavaScript.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Romanian-language cultivation game about immortality.
- The game is implemented as a single-player browser experience.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- The user requested: “Creaza un mmorpg cu imortal si cultivation”.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained game titled “Calea Nemuritorului — Tărâmul cețurilor”; multiplayer is not implemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the canvas-rendered game with combat, meditation, Qi cultivation and breakthroughs, quests, inventory, techniques, touch controls, and localStorage saves.
- Fixed a malformed CSS gradient in `index.html`; `.topbar` and other interface panels now compute as positioned.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`; browser console has no errors after reload.
- Captured and inspected screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/cultivation-final.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/modal-check.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate gameplay, especially meditation/Qi gain, combat, inventory, and mobile layout.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Investigate why a browser check showed Qi remained `0 / 100` after starting meditation, despite meditation being active.
2. Exercise combat, healing/items, breakthrough progression, and touch controls in the browser.
3. Recheck responsive layout and capture a final screenshot if changes are made.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation, styling, rendering, UI, and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- Local browser server is running on port `3002`.
- Changes are uncommitted.
